smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001628315.description: We are looking for self-driven individuals to join our Moveworks Technical Support team, supporting a sophisticated Moveworks ServiceNow platform powered by machine learning, enterprise search (RAG), and agentic workflows. This role sits at the intersection of understanding a complex AI driven product and clearly communicating its behavior and value to our growing customer base. Our platform enables users to not only find answers but also automate tasks end to end through AI agents that reason, plan, and execute actions across enterprise systems . As a result, customer questions range from configuration guidance to deeper investigations into why the assistant behaved a certain way spanning both educational support and complex debugging of AI behavior, integrations, and workflows. An ideal candidate is curious, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, with a strong appetite for learning and solving complex technical problems. conversational AI Understanding of agent-based or workflow automation systems Familiarity with configuration file formats such as XML, JSON, and YAML Experience with logging and observability tools smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001631469.description: What you get to do in this role: You will build and operate components of our Kubernetes platform and its core subsystems, taking ownership of well-defined pieces as you grow into broader areas. You will write a lot of Go (controllers, operators, platform services, and the automation around them) and take part in code review with the team. You will take well-scoped features and fixes from design through to production, working with senior engineers on direction and design choices. You will help operate what the team builds: on-call, incident investigation, and contributing to the follow-up work that stops the same failure twice. You will work with the teams that run workloads on the platform, helping them get the most out of it. You will work on a platform that serves regulated markets, where compliance constraints including FedRAMP shape design choices. To be successful in this role you have: Experience using or thinking critically about AI in engineering work, such as AI-powered coding and operational tooling, workflow automation, or how AI changes the way software and infrastructure are built. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, including deploying workloads and debugging them when they misbehave. Contributions to platform components, tooling, or operators are a strong plus. 2+ years building production software. Programming skills in Go, or solid skills in another systems language and a clear willingness to work primarily in Go. Familiarity with at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) and its core compute, networking, and IAM concepts. Working knowledge of containers, CI/CD and GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code. Curiosity about how AI changes platform engineering, whether through AI-powered tooling, automating operational work, or rethinking how infrastructure is built and run. It also helps if you have: Exposure to Kubernetes controllers or operators and the operator pattern. Exposure to container networking (CNI), service mesh, or workload identity and mTLS. Exposure to secrets management, certificate lifecycle, or similar core platform subsystems. Experience with observability tooling, including metrics, tracing, and SLOs. Experience with managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), Terraform, or Crossplane. Work Personas We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. workday:paypal:/job/Bangalore-Karnataka-.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Under summary section Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come! Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions May contribute to code & design reviews Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What you need to know about the role: PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. Meet our team: Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. Your way to impact: As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Zettle mobile app features on Android and iOS. Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause. Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. Tes
